entries.jp: 龍さん\n歌はほどほどにして\nおいた方がいいぜよ
entries.en: Ryo-san, you'd\nbetter go easy on\nthe singin'.

entries.jp: なんでじゃ？
entries.en: Why's that?

entries.jp: って　弥太郎　\nお前  今までどこへ\n行ってたんだ
entries.en: Hey, wait, Yataro!\nWhere've you\nbeen all this time?

entries.jp: どこって　大舞台の会場で\n龍さんが武士と揉めてた\nから　身を隠しとったぜよ
entries.en:
Where? Back at
the audition hall
you were scufflin'
with a samurai,
Ryo-san, so I
went and hid.

entries.jp: お　お前なぁ\n親友なら助けるのが\n筋ってもんだろうが！
entries.en:
W-why, you... A
best friend's
s'posed to help
out, ain't he!?

entries.jp: 揉め事は範囲外\nオレのような色男は\n金と力はないのが相場ぜよ
entries.en:
Brawls ain't my
department. A
handsome fella
like me's got no
money or
muscle--that's just
how it goes.

entries.jp: お　おう……
entries.en: R-right...

entries.jp: で　話の続きじゃが
entries.en: So, back to what I\nwas sayin'.

entries.jp: どうやら　ここ京では\n免状のないモンが\n勝手に歌うと――
entries.en:
Seems here in
Kyoto, if anybody
without a license
goes and sings--

entries.jp: 歌うと？
entries.en: If they sing?

entries.jp: \fnt1\col1死罪\fnt0\col0らしいぜよ
entries.en: It's \fnt1\col1the death\npenalty\fnt0\col0,\napparently.

entries.jp: なるほどなぁ……\nって\fnt1\col1死罪\fnt0\col0
entries.en: I see... Wait,\n\fnt1\col1DEATH\fnt0\col0!?

entries.jp: それじゃ土佐と\n同じじゃねえか……
entries.en: Then it's no\ndifferent from\nTosa...

entries.jp: 勝手に歌ったらいかん\nってのはちらほらと\n聞いておったが
entries.en:
I'd heard here
and there that
you ain't allowed
to sing as you
please, but...

entries.jp: どうも　日本中が\nそういうことに\nなっているらしい
entries.en: Seems it's like\nthat all over\nJapan.

entries.jp: ただ　大舞台で認められて\n免状さえ持っちょれば\n問題ないようじゃ
entries.en:
But if you pass
the audition and
get a license,
there's no
problem, it seems.

entries.jp:
となると　まずは偉い
先生に認めてもらって
免状をもらわなくちゃ
いかんのか
entries.en:
So first I gotta
get some big-shot
teacher to vouch
for me, and get a
license?

entries.jp: しかし\nそんなモンにアテはないし\n困ったなぁ……
entries.en: But I don't know\nanybody like\nthat... What a fix...

entries.jp: 紹介状なら\nアテがあるぜよ
entries.en:
If it's a letter of
introduction you
need, I got an
idea.

entries.jp: お前　京に\nそんな知り合いが\nおるんか
entries.en: You know\nsomebody like\nthat in Kyoto?

entries.jp: ほら　龍さんにギターを\nくれた　モジャモジャの\nおっさんぜよ
entries.en:
Y'know, that
shaggy old fella
who gave you
your guitar,
Ryo-san.

entries.jp: 自称　偉い先生なんじゃろ\n大舞台への紹介状ぐらい\n書いてくれるかもしれん
entries.en:
Calls himself a
big-shot teacher,
right? He might
write you a letter
for the audition.

entries.jp: それだ！\n今まで　思いつきも\nしなかった！
entries.en: That's it! It never\neven crossed my\nmind!

entries.jp: わしに京へ行け\n言うたんはあの先生だ\nきっと書いてくれる！
entries.en:
He's the one who
told me to go to
Kyoto! He'll write
it for sure!

entries.jp: よし　その先生とやらの\n似顔絵を描いてくれれば\nオレも捜してみる
entries.en:
Alright, if you
draw me a picture
of this teacher,
I'll look for him
too.

entries.jp: おう！　ちょっと待てよ\nこうモジャモジャで……\nこんな感じの……できた！
entries.en:
Sure! Hang on...
All shaggy like
this... kinda like...
done!

entries.jp: 我ながら　そっくりに\n描けたと思うんだが
entries.en: If I do say so\nmyself, it's a dead\nringer.

entries.jp: こ　これは人か？\nモジャモジャすぎる気が\nするぜよ……
entries.en: I-is this even a\nperson? Seems a\nbit too shaggy...

entries.jp: わしの記憶は確かだ\nこんくらいモジャモジャで\nかっこよかった！
entries.en:
My memory's rock
solid! He was this
shaggy, and real
cool!

entries.jp: これ\nかっこええか？
entries.en: This... is cool?

entries.jp: かっこええだろ？\nとにかく　偉い先生だと\n言うておった
entries.en:
Cool, right?
Anyway, he said
he was a big-shot
teacher.

entries.jp: まあ　龍さんが\n偉い先生や言うなら\n問題ないか
entries.en:
Well, if you say
he's a big-shot
teacher, Ryo-san,
guess it's fine.

entries.jp: よーし　明日から\nこの人を捜しに\n行くぜよ！
entries.en:
Alright! Startin'
tomorrow, I'm
goin' lookin' for
this guy!

entries.jp:
翌日から龍馬はテラーダの
仕事の合間を縫っては
土佐で会った謎の旅人
捜しを始めたのだった
entries.en:
From the next
day, between jobs
at the Terada,
Ryoma began
searching for the
mysterious
traveler he had
met in Tosa.

entries.jp: すまんが　\nこん紙に描いてあるような\n人を知らんか？
entries.en:
Sorry to bother
ya, but d'you
know anybody
who looks like the
fella on this
paper?

entries.jp: いやぁ\n知らないなぁ
entries.en: Nope, can't say I\ndo.

entries.jp: そっちのあんたは\n知らんか？
entries.en: How 'bout you\nthere?

entries.jp: って言ってもこの絵だけで\n名前もわからんのじゃねえ
entries.en: Even so, with just\nthis picture and\nno name...

entries.jp: そうか……
entries.en: I see...

entries.jp:
しかし　京の都は広い
名前も知らぬ男を
捜すのは簡単なこと
ではなかった
entries.en:
But the capital,
Kyoto, was vast.
Finding a man
whose name he
didn't know was
no easy task.

entries.jp: いや　ここで簡単に\n諦めるわけにはいかんぜよ
entries.en: No, I can't give up\nthat easy!

entries.jp: わしの歌を\n認めてもらうためにも\n捜しださんと！
entries.en: I gotta find him,\nso my songs can\nget recognized!

entries.jp: しかし\n龍馬は諦めない
entries.en: Still, Ryoma did\nnot give up.

entries.jp: それにあれから練習した\n歌をモジャの先生に\n聴いて欲しいぜよ
entries.en:
Besides, I want
Shaggy Sensei to
hear the songs
I've practiced
since then.

entries.jp: 元気だといいなあ\nモジャモジャの先生
entries.en: Hope he's doin'\nwell, the Shaggy\nSensei.

entries.jp: よっしゃ！　明日は\nあっちの方を捜すぜよ！
entries.en:
Alright!
Tomorrow I'll
search over that
way!

entries.jp:
テラーダでの仕事に精を
出しながらも　毎日毎日
モジャモジャの先生捜しに
そして歌の練習にと
奔走するのであった
entries.en:
Working hard at
the Terada, he
ran around every
single day,
hunting for the
Shaggy Sensei
and practicing his
songs.

entries.jp: 龍ちゃん　ちょっと！\n出前の配達は
entries.en: Ryo-chan, hold\non! What about\nthe delivery?

entries.jp: すまんがやっといてくれ\n大事な用があるんだ！
entries.en:
Sorry, can you
handle it? I got
somethin'
important to do!

entries.jp: もう！　最近はすーぐ\nどっか行くんだから！
entries.en:
Honestly! Lately
you're always
running off
somewhere!

entries.jp: そうじゃない時は店の裏で\nやかましくがなってるし
entries.en:
And when you're
not, you're out
back of the shop
making an awful
racket.

entries.jp:
あれ　なにかしら？
歌？　歌にしちゃあ
ずいぶん
下手なのよねぇ
entries.en:
What is that,
anyway? Singing?
Awfully bad for
singing, isn't it?

entries.jp:
歌だといろいろ
まずいけどあれだけ
下手だとわからないから
いいかしら？
entries.en:
Singing could get
us in all sorts of
trouble, but when
it's that bad, no
one can tell, so
maybe it's fine?

entries.jp: ま　店の中じゃないし\nな～んか一生懸命だから\n見逃してあげましょうかね
entries.en:
Well, it's not
inside the shop,
and he's trying
ever so hard, so I
suppose I'll let it
slide.

entries.jp: んふっ　何かに夢中に\nなってる男って\nいいものだものね～ぇ
entries.en:
Tee hee. There's
just something
about a man who's
crazy about
something, isn't
there~?

entries.jp: ふう……\n今日も見つからなかった
entries.en: Phew... No luck\nagain today.

entries.jp: わしの絵が悪いのか？\nいや　しかし
entries.en: Is my drawing no\ngood? No, but...

entries.jp: このモジャモジャ具合は\nそっくりだと思うんだが
entries.en: I'd say the\nshagginess is spot\non...

entries.jp: 腹減った～\n暗くなったし\nそろそろ戻るか
entries.en:
I'm starvin'... It's
getting dark.
Reckon I'll head
back.

entries.jp: 肩を落とし\nテラーダへと戻る龍馬
entries.en:
Shoulders
slumped, Ryoma
headed back to
the Terada.

entries.jp: そんな龍馬を見つめる\n二つの影があった
entries.en: Two shadows\nwere watching\nRyoma go.

entries.jp: 間違いない　あの絵は\nあれは松陰先生だ
entries.en:
No doubt about it.
That drawing...
that's
Shoin-sensei.

entries.jp:
そうですか？
あれは緑花椰菜
（ブロッコリー）の絵じゃ
ないですかね……
entries.en:
Is it? Isn't that a
drawing of a
head of
broccoli...?

entries.jp: いや　野郎は\nあんな頭をした人って\n言ってやがった
entries.en:
No. That guy said
it was somebody
with a head like
that.

entries.jp: この京であんな\nロックな髪型をしてるのは\n松陰先生の他にいない
entries.en:
In all of Kyoto,
there's nobody
with a hairstyle
that rock except
Shoin-sensei.

entries.jp: それもそうですね\n……あ　いいものみっけ
entries.en: That's true\nenough... Oh, look\nwhat I found.

entries.jp: そう言うといそいそと\n何かを拾い上げる一人
entries.en:
With that, one of
them eagerly
picked something
up.

entries.jp: もう一人はじっと\n龍馬を睨んでいた
entries.en: The other kept\nglaring at Ryoma.

entries.jp: 見るからに\n怪しいヤロウだ
entries.en: That guy looks\nshady as hell.

entries.jp: あいつ……松陰先生に\n何しやがった
entries.en: What the hell did\nhe do to\nShoin-sensei...?

entries.jp: そうと決まった\nわけじゃないでしょ
entries.en: We don't know\nthat he did\nanything, do we?

entries.jp: 松陰先生を捜してるなら\n敵に決まっている
entries.en:
If he's looking for
Shoin-sensei, he's
an enemy.
Obviously.

entries.jp: 敵ねえ……私には\nそうは見えないですが\n……よいしょっと
entries.en:
An enemy, hm...
He doesn't look
like one to me...
Hup!

entries.jp: 根拠は？
entries.en: Based on what?

entries.jp: おっ これは！なかなかの\nレアものですよ！\nうんうん　夢が膨らむなあ
entries.en:
Oh, this is...!
Quite a rare find!
Yes, yes, the
possibilities are
endless!

entries.jp: っておい！\n人の話をちゃんと\n聞いてるのかよ！
entries.en: Hey, come on!\nYou're not even\nlistening to me!

entries.jp: いつものゴミ拾いなら\n後にしてくれ
entries.en: Save your usual\njunk-picking for\nlater.

entries.jp: ゴミ？\nこれは宝の山ですよ\nあなたは頭が固いですねぇ
entries.en:
Junk? This is a
mountain of
treasure. You
really are
hardheaded,
aren't you?

entries.jp: 誰の頭が固いって？\nロックを志すオレ様の頭が\n固いわけねえだろ！
entries.en:
Who're you
calling
hardheaded? The
great Takasugi
lives for rock! No
way is he
hardheaded!

entries.jp: じゃあ　この素晴らしさが\nわかりますよね\nはい　半分持って
entries.en:
Then you can
appreciate how
wonderful this is.
Here, carry half.

entries.jp: お　おう？\nって　重てぇっ！
entries.en: Uh, sure? Whoa,\nthis is heavy!

entries.jp: 落としたりしないで\nくださいね
entries.en: Please don't drop\nany of it.

entries.jp: 後ですっごい\n発明品へと変身\nするんですから
entries.en:
Later on, it's
going to turn into
an amazing
invention, you
see.

entries.jp: その変な\n発明の話はいいんだ\nアイツだよ　アイツ！
entries.en:
Forget your weird
inventions! I'm
talking about him!
HIM!

entries.jp: ああ　えっとね\nもしかしたら　彼は\n松陰先生のお弟子さんかも
entries.en:
Ah, well, you
see... perhaps he's
one of
Shoin-sensei's
disciples.

entries.jp: はぁっ？\nあんなボンクラが？\nねえ！　それは絶対ねえ！
entries.en: Huh!? That\ndimwit? No way!\nNo way in hell!

entries.jp: そうですか？\nだって彼の歌ってた歌は
entries.en:
You think so?
After all, the
song he was
singing...

entries.jp: 確かに下手だったけど\nロックだったと\n思いますよ？
entries.en:
It was bad,
certainly, but I do
believe it was
rock, wasn't it?

entries.jp: 違う！\nあれはロックじゃねえ！
entries.en: No! That wasn't\nrock!

entries.jp: あんな勢いだけの歌\nロックと認めてたまるか！
entries.en:
A song that's
nothing but
momentum? Like
hell I'll call that
rock!

entries.jp: でも\n明らかに天歌では\nありませんでした
entries.en: But it clearly\nwasn't the\nHeaven's Song.

entries.jp: そうだとしても\nあんなヘタクソ\nロックじゃねぇ！
entries.en: Even so, a lousy\namateur like that\nain't rock!

entries.jp: まあ　まだ確信もないし\nもうちょっと見張って\nみましょうよ
entries.en:
Well, we can't be
sure yet. Let's
keep watching
him a little
longer.

entries.jp: 見張ったって同じだと\n思うが　仕方ねぇ
entries.en:
Watching him
won't change a
thing, if you ask
me. But fine.

entries.jp: だが　絶対に\n正体を暴いてやるぜ……
entries.en: Either way, I'm\ngonna expose him\nfor what he is...

entries.jp: はぁ……結局\n手がかりはなしか
entries.en: Haah... No leads\nin the end, huh.

entries.jp: ちょっとぉ\n何しょぼくれてんのよ\n龍ちゃんらしくもない
entries.en:
Hey, now, what
are you moping
for? That's not
like you,
Ryo-chan.

entries.jp: なんかあったの？\nおなかでも痛い？
entries.en: Did something\nhappen? Got a\ntummy ache?

entries.jp: そうじゃないぜよ\nわしの捜してる\n歌の先生に
entries.en:
It ain't that. It's
the singin'
teacher I'm lookin'
for...

entries.jp: なかなか会えなくて
entries.en: ...I just can't seem\nto find him.

entries.jp: アタシ　歌のことは\nよくわかんないけど
entries.en: I don't know much\nabout singing,\nbut...

entries.jp: その先生って天歌の\n先生なの？
entries.en:
...is this teacher
of yours a
Heaven's Song
teacher?

entries.jp: わからん\nだが　偉い先生だって\n言うとった
entries.en:
Couldn't tell ya.
But he said he
was a big-shot
teacher.

entries.jp: なるほどねえ
entries.en: I see.

entries.jp: その先生に会えたら\n免状がもらえて好きに\n歌えるって思ったんだが
entries.en:
I figured if I
could meet him,
I'd get a license
and could sing all
I wanted...

entries.jp: わし……ダメなんじゃろか
entries.en: Maybe I'm just no\ngood, huh...

entries.jp: \fnt1もーっ\nそんな顔しない！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Oh, come on!\nDon't make that\nface!\fnt0

entries.jp: ごほっごほっごほっ！\nお　お登勢やん
entries.en: *Cough, cough,\ncough!*\nO-Otose-yan...

entries.jp: アタシには　龍ちゃんの\n歌は　単にうるさいとしか\n思えないけれど
entries.en:
To me, your
singing's just
plain noise,
Ryo-chan...

entries.jp: っていうか店の裏で\nがなってたあれ　やっぱり\n歌だったの？
entries.en:
Wait, so that
racket out back of
the shop really
WAS singing?

entries.jp: お　お登勢やんは\nわしに　トドメを\nさそうとしてるのか
entries.en: O-Otose-yan, are\nyou tryin' to\nfinish me off?

entries.jp: でもね\nそんなしょぼくれた顔じゃ\nどんな歌も一緒よ　きっと
entries.en:
But listen. With a
sad face like that,
any song would
sound the same,
I'm sure.

entries.jp: アタシはね　あんたの\nバカみたいに元気なところが\n気に入ったのよ
entries.en:
You know, what I
like about you is
how you're so full
of energy, it's
silly.

entries.jp: その元気がないんじゃあ\n龍ちゃんじゃないわ！\n蛇よ　蛇ちゃんよ！
entries.en:
Without that
energy, you're not
Ryo-chan, the
dragon! You're a
snake!
Snake-chan!

entries.jp: \fnt1ぬおおおおおお！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Nuoooooooh!\fnt0

entries.jp: きゃっ\nな　何？
entries.en: Eek! Wh-what?

entries.jp: 確かにそうだ！\nわしは大事なことを\n忘れるところじゃった
entries.en:
You're right! I
almost forgot
somethin'
important!

entries.jp: 大事なこと？
entries.en: Something\nimportant?

entries.jp: 熱情（パッション）\nじゃ！
entries.en: Passion!

entries.jp: 歌うわしが熱情を\n忘れたら　何にもならん
entries.en:
If I forget my
passion when I
sing, it's all for
nothin'!

entries.jp: お登勢やん　\nわしは目が覚めたぜよ
entries.en: Otose-yan, you\nwoke me right up,\nI tell ya!

entries.jp: そ　そう\nま　今日はもういいから\n先生でも捜してきなさい
entries.en:
R-right. Well,
that's enough
work for today.
Go look for your
teacher.

entries.jp: いいのか？\nだが店の仕事が……
entries.en: You sure? But the\nwork at the shop...

entries.jp: 店で辛気くさい顔されても\nアタシが困るのよ
entries.en:
If you're going to
mope around the
shop, that's just a
nuisance for me.

entries.jp: それならさっさと\n先生捜して免状とやらを\n書いてもらって
entries.en:
So hurry up and
find your teacher,
get him to write
you this license or
whatever...

entries.jp: ばーんと有名になって\n出世払いでツケを\n返してちょーだい！
entries.en:
...hit it big, and
pay off your tab
once you've made
it!

entries.jp: おおっ！
entries.en: Ooh!

entries.jp: ほら　お昼ごはんに特製の\n大盛りシーフードピッツァ\n焼いたから　これ食べて
entries.en:
Here, I baked you
a special
extra-large
seafood pizza for
lunch. Eat up.

entries.jp: うお～っ！\nこれは美味そうだ！
entries.en: Whoaaa! That\nlooks delicious!

entries.jp: 何からなにまですまん\nお登勢やん　愛してる！
entries.en:
Sorry for
everything,
Otose-yan! I love
ya!

entries.jp: まっ　この子ったら\nしょうがないから\nハムもサービスしちゃう！
entries.en:
My, this boy! Oh,
fine, I'll throw in
some ham on the
house!

entries.jp: うおおお！\n元気出てきたぜよ！\nこの恩は必ず返すから！
entries.en:
Whooaa! I'm all
fired up now! I'll
pay you back for
this, I swear!

entries.jp: はいはい\n頑張ってね！
entries.en: Yes, yes. Do your\nbest!

entries.jp: そうと決まれば\n腹ごしらえじゃ！
entries.en: Now that that's\nsettled, time to\nfill my belly!

entries.jp: あむっあむあむあむ！\nやっぱお登勢やんの\nぴっつぁは最高だ～！
entries.en:
*Munch, munch,
munch!*
Otose-yan's pizza
really is the best~!

entries.jp: ほ～んと困った男だけど\nこの食いっぷりを見てたら\n憎めないのよねえ
entries.en:
He's such a
hopeless boy, but
watching him eat
like that, I just
can't stay mad at
him.

entries.jp: 何か本当にでっかいことを\nやりそうな気がするよ\nアタシは……
entries.en:
I have a feeling
he's going to do
something really
big someday...

entries.jp: は～　満腹満腹\nお登勢やんはほんとに\nいい人ぜよ
entries.en:
Haah, stuffed!
Otose-yan's a real
good person, I
tell ya.

entries.jp: 恩に報いるためにも\n早く先生を捜さんと
entries.en: I gotta find my\nteacher soon, if\nonly to repay her.

entries.jp: でも　その前にちょっくら\n歌っていくか！
entries.en: But before that,\nhow 'bout a little\nsingin'!

entries.jp: なんだか歌いたくて\nたまらん気分じゃ
entries.en: Somehow I'm just\nitchin' to sing.

entries.jp: ここでだったら\n怒られることもないしな
entries.en: Nobody'll yell at\nme here, anyhow.

entries.jp: 早く大勢の前ででっかく\n歌うてみたいぜよ……
entries.en:
I sure wanna sing
big in front of a
huge crowd
soon...

entries.jp: そう言って\n龍馬はいつもの\n練習場所へやってきた
entries.en: With that, Ryoma\ncame to his usual\npractice spot.

entries.jp: しかし　いつもは\n龍馬だけのその場所に\n子供たちがいた
entries.en:
But the spot that
was usually
Ryoma's alone
had children in it.

entries.jp: 少し前の\n龍馬と同じように\nしょんぼりとしている
entries.en:
They looked as
downcast as
Ryoma had a little
earlier.

entries.jp: お前ら\nどうしたんだ？\n腹でも痛いのか？
entries.en:
What's wrong
with you kids?
Got a tummy
ache?

entries.jp: 違うよ　僕たち\n雷舞に行けないのが\n悲しいんだ
entries.en: No. We're sad\n'cause we can't go\nto the live.

entries.jp: 雷舞？　もしかして\nその手に持っちょる\nチラシのか？
entries.en:
A live? Don't tell
me, the one on
that flyer you're
holdin'?

entries.jp: うん　今一番人気の\n愛獲（アイドル）\n『新選組』の雷舞だよ
entries.en:
Yeah. It's the live
of the
Shinsengumi, the
most popular
idols right now!

entries.jp: ほほう\nこれはなかなか\n美男（イケメン）だなぁ
entries.en: Well, well. These\nare some real\nhandsome fellas.

entries.jp: おこづかい\nいっぱい貯めて\n買いにいったのに
entries.en:
We saved up lots
of pocket money
and went to buy
tickets...

entries.jp: 大人の人に\n突き飛ばされて\n買えなかったんだ
entries.en:
...but some
grown-ups
shoved us out of
the way and we
couldn't get any.

entries.jp: そりゃひどい話じゃ\n怪我はしてないか？
entries.en: Now that's just\nawful. You ain't\nhurt, are ya?

entries.jp: ちょっと\nすりむいたけど\n大丈夫だよ
entries.en: I scraped myself\na little, but I'm\nokay.

entries.jp: それにしても大の大人が\n子供を押しのけるなんて\nすごい人気なんだな
entries.en:
Still, grown men
shovin' kids
aside... They must
be real popular.

entries.jp: うん　それにね\n券はえらい人から順番に\n買える決まりだから
entries.en:
Yeah. And
besides, the rule
is that important
people get to buy
tickets first...

entries.jp: 町民に残る券って\nちょっぴりしかないんだ\nだから仕方ないよ
entries.en:
...so there's only a
tiny few left for
townsfolk. So it
can't be helped.

entries.jp: むう……音楽を\n楽しむのに身分の差が\n関係あるとは
entries.en:
Hmm... So your
rank decides
whether you get
to enjoy music...

entries.jp: せちがらい世の中ぜよ\n天歌ってのは不自由な\n音楽だなぁ
entries.en:
What a cold, hard
world. This
Heaven's Song
sure is a stifling
kind of music.

entries.jp: 免状がないと\n歌えんどころか
entries.en: Not only can't you\nsing without a\nlicense...

entries.jp: 自由に聴くことすら\n叶わんのか……
entries.en: ...you can't even\nlisten freely...?

entries.jp: 天歌は\nもともとお侍様の\n歌だもん
entries.en:
The Heaven's
Song was always
the samurai lords'
music, you know.

entries.jp: 僕たちはちょっとでも\n聴けたらいい方だよ
entries.en: We're lucky if we\nget to hear even a\nlittle.

entries.jp: それに今日はこのチラシを\nもらえたからいいんだ
entries.en: Besides, it's okay,\n'cause today we\ngot this flyer.

entries.jp: チラシだってなかなか\n手に入らないんだぜ！
entries.en: Even flyers are\nreal hard to get,\nyou know!

entries.jp: む　むむ～っ
entries.en: Hm, hmmmm...

entries.jp: だが　聴きたいだろ？\n聴きたい音楽が聴けない\nその気持ちよーくわかる！
entries.en:
But you wanna
hear it, right? Not
bein' able to hear
the music you
want--I know that
feelin' all too well!

entries.jp: うん……\nでも\nもういいんだ
entries.en: Yeah... But it's\nokay now.

entries.jp: 諦めるのは早いぜよ\n音楽を楽しむには別の\n方法もある
entries.en:
Too early to give
up! There's other
ways to enjoy
music.

entries.jp: えっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 新選組じゃあないが\nわしが雷舞をしてやるぜよ
entries.en:
I ain't the
Shinsengumi, but
I'll put on a live
for ya!

entries.jp: ええっ\nそ　そんなの\nダメだよ！
entries.en: Whaaa? Y-you\ncan't do that!

entries.jp: 勝手に音楽をやったら\n怒られちゃうよ！
entries.en:
If you play music
without
permission, you'll
get in trouble!

entries.jp: 大丈夫\nここなら誰も来ない
entries.en: It's fine. Nobody\ncomes around\nhere.

entries.jp: それに　誰もが好きに\n音楽を楽しめんような\n世の中は間違っとる
entries.en:
Besides, a world
where folks can't
enjoy music as
they please is just
plain wrong.

entries.jp: わしはそう思う
entries.en: That's what I\nthink.

entries.jp: お兄ちゃん……
entries.en: Mister...

entries.jp: なんかあったら\nわしが全部\n責任とってやる
entries.en: If anything\nhappens, I'll take\nall the blame.

entries.jp: お前らはただ音楽を\n楽しめばいいんだ
entries.en: All you gotta do is\nenjoy the music.

entries.jp: でも……いいの？\nこんな路地裏で
entries.en: But... is it really\nokay? In a back\nalley like this?

entries.jp: いいんだ！
entries.en: Sure it is!

entries.jp: わしのこの声と\nギターさえあれば！\nそこが雷舞会場になる！
entries.en:
So long as I got
my voice and this
guitar,
anywhere's a live
venue!

entries.jp: 弥太郎！\n雷舞するぞ
entries.en: Yataro! We're\ndoin' a live!

entries.jp: おうよ！\n龍さん
entries.en: You got it,\nRyo-san!

entries.jp: あれはっ……\n松陰先生の\nギター
entries.en: That's...\nShoin-sensei's\nguitar...

entries.jp: 今からお前らに　わしが\n新しい音楽を聴かせてやる
entries.en:
Now I'm gonna let
you kids hear a
brand-new kind
of music.

entries.jp: 耳ぃかっぽじって聴くぜよ\nこれが音楽の夜明けじゃ！
entries.en:
Open your ears
wide and listen
up! This here's
the dawn of
music!

entries.jp: \fnt1待てっ\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Hold it!\fnt0

entries.jp: な　なんだ
entries.en: Wh-what the...

entries.jp: てめぇ　そのギター\nどうやって手に入れた
entries.en: You. That guitar.\nHow'd you get\nyour hands on it?

entries.jp: 飛び出してきた男は\n龍馬の胸ぐらを\n掴み睨み付ける
entries.en:
The man who had
leapt out grabbed
Ryoma by the
collar and glared
at him.

entries.jp: どうって……
entries.en: How'd I...?

entries.jp: それは松陰先生の宝だ！\nもしやてめぇ　松陰先生に\n何かしたのか？
entries.en:
That's
Shoin-sensei's
treasure! Don't
tell me you did
something to
Shoin-sensei?

entries.jp: だったらタダじゃおかねえ\nおい！　なんとか言え！
entries.en: If you did, you're\ngonna pay! Hey!\nSay something!

entries.jp: わっ　わわわっっ\n乱暴はやめるぜよ！
entries.en: Wh-whoa, whoa,\nwhoa! Quit\nroughin' me up!

entries.jp: 黙ってねえでなんとか\n言え！盗んだのか\n奪ったのか
entries.en:
Don't just stand
there, say
something! Did
you steal it? Rob
him?

entries.jp: この泥棒野郎！\n松陰先生をどうしたんだ！
entries.en:
You lousy thief!
Tell me what you
did to
Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: まっ　うぷっ　うおっっ\n首が絞まっ……うぐっ\nほげぇぇぇ～っ
entries.en: Wai-- *urk* Whoa!\nMy neck's-- *gurk*\nHoggyaaaah~!

entries.jp: ほげぇ\nじゃねえっ！
entries.en: Don't you\n"hoggyah" me!

entries.jp: まあまあ 晋作落ち着いて\nそれじゃ無理ですよ\n首が締まっちゃってるもの
entries.en:
Now, now,
Shinsaku, calm
down. He can't
answer like that.
You're choking
him.

entries.jp: えっ？\nああ
entries.en: Huh? Oh.

entries.jp: もう一人の男に指摘され\n男は慌てて手を離した
entries.en: Prompted by the\nother man, he\nhurriedly let go.

entries.jp: ごほっごほっごほっ……\nな　なんじゃ\nお前らは？
entries.en:
*Cough, cough,
cough...*
Wh-what's the big
idea? Who are
you two?

entries.jp: ふふっ\nいきなり手荒なことをして\nすみませんでした
entries.en:
Heh. I'm sorry for
the rough
treatment out of
nowhere.

entries.jp: でも　不用意にギターを\n弾かない方がいいですよ
entries.en:
But you really
shouldn't play a
guitar so
carelessly.

entries.jp: 京では自由に音楽を\n奏でるんは禁じられてると\nいうアレか？
entries.en:
You mean that
business about
how in Kyoto you
ain't allowed to
play music as you
please?

entries.jp: そうそう\n知ってるんじゃ\nないですか
entries.en: That's right. So\nyou do know.

entries.jp: ああ　でも　こいつらの\n話を聞いてたらいても\nたってもいられなくて
entries.en:
Yeah, but hearin'
these kids' story, I
just couldn't sit
still.

entries.jp: 好きに音楽を聴けないのは\n間違ってる\nそう思ったんだ
entries.en:
Not bein' able to
listen to music as
you please is
wrong. That's
what I figured.

entries.jp: ……幕府と\n戦う気なんですか？
entries.en: ...Do you intend to\nfight the\nshogunate?

entries.jp: おいっ！
entries.en: Hey!

entries.jp: そんなモンは\nわからん！
entries.en: I wouldn't know\nabout all that!

entries.jp: なのに歌おうと\nしたんですか？
entries.en: And yet you tried\nto sing?

entries.jp: わからんが……\n歌わなくちゃと\n思ったんだ！
entries.en: I dunno... I just\nfigured I had to\nsing!

entries.jp: あっはははははは！\n君　バカでしょう！
entries.en: Ahahahahaha!\nYou're an idiot,\naren't you!

entries.jp: 確かに　こいつの名は\n\fnt1バカ\fnt0に決まったな
entries.en: Yep. His name's\nofficially \fnt1Idiot\fnt0\nnow.

entries.jp: バカとは何じゃ！\nわしには坂本龍馬ちゅう\n立派な名前があるぜよ！
entries.en:
Who're you callin'
an idiot!? I got a
fine name, I'll
have you know:
Ryoma Sakamoto!

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　ですか
entries.en: Ryoma-kun, is it?

entries.jp: 私は長州の桂小五郎\nこっちでふくれてるのが\n同じく長州の高杉晋作
entries.en:
I'm Kogoro
Katsura of
Choshu. And the
one sulking over
here is Shinsaku
Takasugi, also of
Choshu.

entries.jp: ふくれてねえ！
entries.en: I'm not sulking!

entries.jp: 桂と高杉……
entries.en: Katsura and\nTakasugi...

entries.jp: おい\n気安くオレ様の名前を\n呼ぶんじゃねえ！
entries.en:
Hey! Don't go
tossing the great
Takasugi's name
around like we're
pals!

entries.jp: てめぇみたいな盗人野郎に\n呼ばれる名前なんざ\n持ち合わせてないんだ
entries.en:
I don't have a
name for some
thieving punk like
you to call me by!

entries.jp: 盗人だと？\n誰が盗人だ！
entries.en: Thief!? Who're\nyou callin' a thief!

entries.jp: そのギターが確かな\n証拠だ！
entries.en: That guitar is all\nthe proof I need!

entries.jp: ギター？\nアホなことを言うな！\nこれはもらったんだ！
entries.en: The guitar? Don't\ntalk nonsense! It\nwas given to me!

entries.jp: 嘘つけ！\nそれは先生の宝物なんだ！\nおいそれと人に渡すか！
entries.en:
Liar! That's
Sensei's treasure!
He'd never just
hand it over to
anybody!

entries.jp: そうは言うても\nもらったもんは\nもらったんだ！
entries.en: You can say that\nall you want, but\ngiven is given!

entries.jp: 嘘つけ！
entries.en: Liar!

entries.jp: ついてない！
entries.en: I ain't lyin'!

entries.jp: やるか！
entries.en: Wanna go!?

entries.jp: 受けて立つぜよ！
entries.en: Bring it on!

entries.jp: アホか　馬鹿馬鹿しい
entries.en: Get real. This is\nstupid.

entries.jp: 見てないで止めてくれ
entries.en: Don't just watch,\nstop him!

entries.jp: 受けて立つぜよ！\nなんやら知らんが\n売られた喧嘩は買うぜよ
entries.en:
Bring it on! I
dunno what this
is about, but I
never back down
from a fight!

entries.jp: おもしれえ\nオレ様と\nやろうってのか
entries.en: Interesting. You\nwanna take on\nyours truly?

entries.jp: お前はよう知らんが\n盗人言われちゃ黙っとれん
entries.en:
I don't know you
from Adam, but I
won't keep quiet
when I'm called a
thief.

entries.jp: ごちゃごちゃ言うとらんと\nかかってこい
entries.en: Quit yappin' and\ncome at me!

entries.jp: 言われなくとも\nそうするぜっ！
entries.en: You don't have to\ntell me twice!

entries.jp: アホか\n馬鹿馬鹿しい
entries.en: Get real. This is\nstupid.

entries.jp: なんだとぉっ
entries.en: What'd you say!?

entries.jp: そんなことで喧嘩なんか\nする気はないぜよ
entries.en:
I ain't got any
intention of
fightin' over
somethin' like
that.

entries.jp: てめぇになくとも\nこっちには\n十分あるんだよ！
entries.en: You might not,\nbut I've got\nplenty!

entries.jp: こないなら\nこっちから行くぜ！
entries.en: If you won't come,\nI'm coming at you!

entries.jp: そこのお前！\n見とらんと止めてくれ！
entries.en: Hey, you there!\nQuit watchin' and\nstop him!

entries.jp: え？　私？
entries.en: Huh? Me?

entries.jp: 止めるな　桂さん！\nこれは先生のためなんだ！
entries.en: Don't stop me,\nKatsura-san! This\nis for Sensei!

entries.jp: しょうがない\nですねぇ……
entries.en: Well, it can't be\nhelped...

entries.jp: こないなら\nこっちから行くぜ！
entries.en: If you won't come,\nI'm coming at you!

entries.jp: いってぇぇぇぇ！\nそのハリセン\nどっから出した
entries.en:
OWWWWW!
Where'd you pull
that paper fan
from!?

entries.jp: え？\n懐からですけど？
entries.en: Hm? From inside\nmy robe, of\ncourse.

entries.jp: すごい\n目にも止まらぬ早業とは\nこのことぜよ……
entries.en:
Amazin'... So that's
what they mean
by too fast for the
eye to see...

entries.jp: とにかく落ち着きなさい\n子供たちも怯えてます
entries.en:
In any case, calm
down. You're
frightening the
children.

entries.jp: （がくがく）
entries.en: (*shiver shiver*)

entries.jp: （ぶるぶる）
entries.en: (*tremble\ntremble*)

entries.jp: ちっ！\nでも訳を聞かねえことには\nオレ様は納得できないぞ！
entries.en:
Tch! But yours
truly won't be
satisfied without
an explanation!

entries.jp: 訳と言っても……
entries.en: An explanation,\nhuh...

entries.jp: あのね　そのギターは\n私達の師匠のものなんです
entries.en: You see, that\nguitar belongs to\nour master.

entries.jp: お前らの師匠？
entries.en: Your master?

entries.jp: そう\n西洋のロックの神様が\n使っていたギターでね
entries.en:
Yes. It's a guitar
once used by a
god of rock from
the West.

entries.jp: 師匠はとても大切に\nしてたんだ
entries.en: Our master\ntreasured it\ndearly.

entries.jp: 西洋のロックの神様\nほえ～　これはそんなに\n大事なもんだったんか
entries.en:
A god of rock
from the West...
Whoa, so this
here's somethin'
that precious,
huh.

entries.jp: だからだな……
entries.en: So that's why...

entries.jp: それでか！　\nこいつを持つと\nいくらでも歌えたのは！
entries.en:
So that's why!
Whenever I hold
this thing, I can
sing forever!

entries.jp: は？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 元々歌が好きだったが\nこいつを手に入れてからは\nもっと好きになったんだ！
entries.en:
I always loved
singin', but ever
since I got this, I
love it even more!

entries.jp: おい
entries.en: Hey.

entries.jp: 前のが鰹のたたきとすると\n今はそれにしょうがを\nどっさりのせた感じぜよ！
entries.en:
If before was
seared bonito,
now it's like
seared bonito
with a whole heap
of ginger on top,
I tell ya!

entries.jp: なあ　桂さん\nこいつの言ってることが\nわかるか？
entries.en:
Hey, Katsura-san.
Do you have any
clue what this
guy's saying?

entries.jp: いやぁ\n私にもちょっと
entries.en: Well, it's a bit\nbeyond me too...

entries.jp: というか\nてめェは\n人の話を聞け！
entries.en: More to the point,\nyou, listen when\npeople talk!

entries.jp: あと　鰹のたたきには\n唐辛子だろ！
entries.en: And seared bonito\ngoes with chili\npepper, obviously!

entries.jp: と　唐辛子っ？\nそんな食べ方は\n聞いたことないぜよ
entries.en: Ch-chili pepper!?\nI never heard of\neatin' it like that!

entries.jp: ふん　やっぱりテメェは\nロックじゃねえぜ
entries.en: Hmph. Just as I\nthought, you're\nnot rock.

entries.jp: む　むむむ……\nたたきに唐辛子をかけて\n食うたらロックなのか？
entries.en:
Hm, hmmm... So if
you eat bonito
with chili pepper,
you're rock?

entries.jp: テメェ\nまさかオレ様のロックを\nバカにしてるのか？
entries.en:
You... You're not
mocking the great
Takasugi's rock,
are you?

entries.jp: バカにって\nお前が言ったんだろ！
entries.en: Makin' fun!?\nYou're the one\nwho said it!

entries.jp: いってぇぇ！　桂さん！\nぽんぽんぽんぽん人の頭を\n叩かないでくれ！
entries.en:
OWWW!
Katsura-san! Quit
whacking me on
the head over and
over!

entries.jp: 悪くなったら\nどうするんだ！
entries.en: What if it makes\nme dumber!

entries.jp: 大丈夫　それ以上悪くは\nなりません　というか\n話がずれてますよ
entries.en:
Don't worry, it
can't get any
worse. More to
the point, we're
getting off track.

entries.jp: っと　そうだった\nとにかくそれは松陰先生の\nお宝なんだ
entries.en:
Oh, right.
Anyway, that's
Shoin-sensei's
treasure.

entries.jp: 簡単にそれを\n手放すわけがねえ
entries.en: No way he'd just\ngive it up that\neasily.

entries.jp: だから　テメェが盗んだか\n奪ったかしたんだろう！
entries.en: So you must've\nstolen it, or\nrobbed him of it!

entries.jp: そんなことはしとらん！\n疑うなら　その松陰先生に\n訊けばいい！
entries.en:
I did no such
thing! If you
doubt me, go ask
this Shoin-sensei
yourself!

entries.jp: 訊けないんですよ
entries.en: We can't ask him.

entries.jp: 松陰先生は旅に出たまま\n消息を絶った
entries.en:
Shoin-sensei set
off on a journey
and vanished
without a trace.

entries.jp: 生きてるか死んでるかも\nわからねえんだ……
entries.en: We don't even\nknow if he's alive\nor dead...

entries.jp: な　なんと\nそうだったんか……
entries.en: Wh-what!? So\nthat's how it is...

entries.jp: ぐすっ
entries.en: *Sniff*

entries.jp: えっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: うお～んおん\nおんおんおん！\nそれは本当に辛かろう！
entries.en:
Waaah-haaah!
Boo-hoo-hoo! That
must be real hard
on ya!

entries.jp: なんでテメェが\n泣いてんだ！
entries.en: Why are YOU\ncrying!?

entries.jp: 大切な人に会えん辛さは\nよーくわかる！
entries.en:
I know all too well
how it hurts not
bein' able to see
someone dear to
ya!

entries.jp: 生死もわからんとなれば\n心配して当然だ！
entries.en:
Not even knowin'
if he's alive or
dead, of course
you'd be worried!

entries.jp: お前らの気持ちを\n考えただけで胸が詰まって\nこう……！
entries.en:
Just thinkin' about
how you two feel,
my chest gets all
tight, and...!

entries.jp: 目が熱ぅなるぜよ！
entries.en: My eyes are\ngettin' all hot, I\ntell ya!

entries.jp: だからその手で\nギターに触んな！
entries.en: So keep your\nhands off that\nguitar!

entries.jp: わしの首を掴んで\n気が済むならいっくらでも\n掴め！　さあさあ！
entries.en:
If grabbin' me by
the neck makes
you feel better,
grab all you want!
Go on, go on!

entries.jp: おい　バカ　やめろ！\n鼻水がつく！
entries.en:
Hey, you idiot,
stop! You're
getting snot on
me!

entries.jp: ねえ……晋作\nこの人は泥棒じゃ\nない気がするんですが
entries.en: Um... Shinsaku, I\ndon't think this\nperson is a thief.

entries.jp: いいや\n桂さんは甘すぎるぜ！\nオレ様は騙されねえ！
entries.en:
No way! You're
way too soft,
Katsura-san!
Nobody fools the
great Takasugi!

entries.jp: さあ　吐け！\n吐くんだ！
entries.en: Now spit it out!\nSpit it out, I said!

entries.jp: 吐けと言われても\n吐くものはないぜよ！
entries.en: Spit what out? I\ngot nothin' to spit\nout!

entries.jp: くそっ\nロックじゃねえ！
entries.en: Dammit! That's\nnot rock!

entries.jp: というか　そもそも\nロックって\nなんなんじゃ
entries.en: Come to think of\nit... what even IS\nrock?

entries.jp: \fnt1えっ？\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Huh?\fnt0

entries.jp: お前　今まで知らずに\n歌ってたのか？
entries.en:
You've been
singing all this
time without
knowing?

entries.jp: モジャモジャの先生にも\nわしの音楽はロックだと\n言われたが
entries.en:
The Shaggy
Sensei told me my
music was rock
too, but...

entries.jp: 詳しいことはな～んも\n教わっとらん！
entries.en: ...he never taught\nme a single thing\nabout it!

entries.jp: じゃあ　今まで君が\n歌ってたのは？
entries.en:
Then what is it
you've been
singing all this
time?

entries.jp: これはわしが考えた\n新しい音楽だ！
entries.en: This here's a new\nkind of music I\ncame up with!

entries.jp: 流れ星と一緒に\nどかーん！　と\n降りてきたんじゃ！
entries.en: It came down to\nme with a shootin'\nstar--KABOOM!

entries.jp: 流れ星……？
entries.en: A shooting star...?

entries.jp: あはっ　あははははっ\nすごいですねぇ
entries.en: Aha, ahahahaha!\nHow remarkable.

entries.jp: こういうのを天才って\n言うんじゃないですか？
entries.en: Isn't this what\nyou'd call a\ngenius?

entries.jp: いや\n天然ですかね？
entries.en: Or perhaps just\nan airhead?

entries.jp: 桂さんが何と言おうとも\n認めねえぞ　オレ様は！
entries.en:
Say what you like,
Katsura-san, I'm
not accepting it!
Not me!

entries.jp: ロックっていうのは\n西洋から来た\n新しい音楽のことですよ
entries.en:
Rock is a new
kind of music that
came over from
the West.

entries.jp: 既成概念や体制に対して\n強い反抗心を持って\n立ち向かう音楽
entries.en:
Music that stands
up to conventions
and the
establishment
with a fierce
spirit of rebellion.

entries.jp: 魂と熱情の\n素晴らしい音楽なんです！
entries.en: It's wonderful\nmusic, full of soul\nand passion!

entries.jp: ほえ～\nお前さん　物知りだなぁ\nセンセーみたいだ
entries.en:
Whoa... You sure
know your stuff,
pal. You're like a
real Sensei.

entries.jp: こんなことは\n基本中の基本ですよ
entries.en: This is the most\nbasic of basics,\nyou know.

entries.jp: 松陰先生はオレ様たちの\nロックの師匠だ
entries.en: Shoin-sensei is\nour rock master.

entries.jp: あの先生\nロックの先生だったんか
entries.en: So that fella was\na rock teacher...

entries.jp: それでわしの歌を\n褒めてくれたんだなぁ
entries.en: No wonder he\npraised my\nsingin'.

entries.jp: お前の歌を褒めたぁ？\n松陰先生が
entries.en: He praised YOUR\nsinging?\nShoin-sensei did?

entries.jp: そうだ\nそんで　このギターを\nわしにくれたんじゃ
entries.en: Yep. And then he\ngave me this\nguitar.

entries.jp: 嘘だっ！\n適当こきやがって
entries.en: Liar! You're\nmaking it up!

entries.jp: そのギターは\nいずれオレ様が先生から\n受け継ぐはずだったんだ
entries.en:
That guitar was
supposed to pass
down from Sensei
to yours truly
someday!

entries.jp: お前みたいなボンクラに\nその資格があるわけがない
entries.en: There's no way a\ndimwit like you\ndeserves it!

entries.jp: そんなこと言われても\nもらったもんは\nもらったとしか……
entries.en:
Even if you say
that, all I can tell
ya is given is
given...

entries.jp: 認めねえ　認めねえ\nオレ様は絶対認めねえ！
entries.en:
I don't accept it, I
don't accept it!
The great
Takasugi will
NEVER accept it!

entries.jp: お前のへなちょこ歌は\nギターに\n相応しくねえ！
entries.en:
Your wimpy little
songs aren't
worthy of that
guitar!

entries.jp: 聴きもせずに\nそんなこと言うな！
entries.en: Don't say that\nwithout even\nlistenin'!

entries.jp: 聴かなくたってわかる！\n唐辛子も食えないくせに！
entries.en:
I don't need to
listen to know!
You can't even
handle chili
pepper!

entries.jp: いや　晋作\n唐辛子とロックは\n関係ないから
entries.en:
Now, Shinsaku,
chili pepper has
nothing to do
with rock.

entries.jp: む　むむむ～っっ！\nそこまで言うなら\nわしの歌を聴くぜよ！
entries.en:
Hm, hmmmm! If
you're gonna go
that far, then
listen to my song!

entries.jp: お兄ちゃん\n歌ってくれるの？
entries.en: Mister, you're\ngonna sing for\nus?

entries.jp: おう！\nお前らも　よーく\n聴くぜよ！
entries.en: You bet! You kids\nlisten up good,\ntoo!

entries.jp: \fnt1ストーップ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1STOOOP!\fnt0

entries.jp: な　なんじゃ
entries.en: Wh-what is it?

entries.jp: 待って　今はまずいです\n見回り隊探知機（レーダー）\nが反応してますからね
entries.en: Wait, now's a bad\ntime. The patrol\nradar is reacting.

entries.jp: 見回り隊れぇだぁ？
entries.en: Patrol ray-dar?

entries.jp: 拾い集めたゴミで\n何を作ってるのかと思えば\nまたそんなもんを……
entries.en:
I wondered what
you were building
out of all that
junk you picked
up, and it's
another one of
those things...

entries.jp: そんなものとはなんです\n役に立つんですよ！
entries.en:
What do you
mean, "those
things"? It's
useful!

entries.jp: 待てぇい！\nそこのお前達！
entries.en: Halt! You there!

entries.jp: ほら　きた！\nこの探知機は\n正確でしょう！
entries.en:
See, here they
come! This radar
is accurate, isn't
it!

entries.jp: ほら　きた\nじゃねえぇ！
entries.en: "Here they come,"\nmy foot!

entries.jp: な　なんだ\nお前らは
entries.en: Wh-who are you\npeople!?

entries.jp: 貴様ら　今\n禁じられている音楽を\n奏でようとしておったな！
entries.en:
You lot were
about to play
forbidden music
just now, weren't
you!

entries.jp: 天歌ではない音楽は\n禁じられていることを\n知らぬわけではあるまい！
entries.en:
Don't pretend you
don't know that
any music but the
Heaven's Song is
forbidden!

entries.jp: だからどうした！\nちょっとギターを\n弾いただけで
entries.en: So what if I was!\nJust for strummin'\na guitar a little...

entries.jp: 捕まえるってのか！
entries.en: ...you're gonna\narrest me!

entries.jp: バカか　あいつは……\nしかし　なんでこんな所に\n見回り隊の連中が……
entries.en:
Is he an idiot...?
But why would
the patrol be
around a place
like this...?

entries.jp: 見てください　あの大荷物\nおそらく雷舞の機材を運ぶ\n途中だったんでしょう
entries.en:
Look at all that
baggage. They
were probably
carrying
equipment for a
live.

entries.jp: それでアイツのギターの\n音を聞きつけてってことか\n厄介なことになったぜ
entries.en:
And they heard
that guy's guitar,
huh. This just got
ugly.

entries.jp: 往来で禁制の音楽を\n奏でるは死罪に値する！\n神妙にお縄につけ！
entries.en:
Playing forbidden
music in the
street warrants
the death penalty!
Surrender
quietly!

entries.jp: そこのガキどもも同罪だ！\n子供だからとてお上に\n楯突くとは容赦せんぞ！
entries.en:
You brats there
are just as guilty!
Defying the
authorities--being
children won't
save you!

entries.jp: ひっ！
entries.en: Eek!

entries.jp: いててっ！\n離せ！　離せよ～！
entries.en: Ow, ow! Let go!\nLet gooo!

entries.jp: おい　お前ら\nその手を離せ！
entries.en: Hey, you! Get\nyour hands off\n'em!

entries.jp: ほざくな！\n反逆者風情が！
entries.en: Silence, you rebel\nscum!

entries.jp: 勝手に音楽を奏でる\nだけでも大罪だと言うのに\n歌を歌うなど言語道断！
entries.en:
Merely playing
music without
permission is a
grave crime, and
to sing a song on
top of it is
unforgivable!

entries.jp:
聴いておったこの
ガキどもも
 一族郎党
並べて磔獄門だ！
entries.en:
These brats who
listened, along
with their entire
families--all of
them will be
crucified and
their heads put
on display!

entries.jp: なっ……！
entries.en: Wha...!

entries.jp: これが京の\n実情ですよ……
entries.en: This is the reality\nof Kyoto...

entries.jp: こうやって幕府は音楽を\n統制し　オレ様たちを\n支配しようとしてやがる
entries.en:
This is how the
shogunate keeps
music on a leash
and tries to lord
it over guys like
us.

entries.jp: だからロックを奏でる\nには幕府と戦う覚悟が\nいるんです
entries.en:
That's why
playing rock
means being
ready to fight the
shogunate.

entries.jp: 京でもそんなことに\nなっちょったんか……
entries.en: So it's come to\nthis even in\nKyoto...

entries.jp: 天歌に逆らい\n反逆の音楽を\n奏でる逆賊めが！
entries.en:
Traitors who defy
the Heaven's Song
and play the
music of
rebellion!

entries.jp: わかったら\nそのクズみたいな楽器を\nこっちに渡せ！
entries.en:
Now that you
understand, hand
over that trash
you call an
instrument!

entries.jp: 大人しく\nお縄につけい！
entries.en: Come quietly!

entries.jp: 二人とも　逃げるぜよ
entries.en: Run for it, you\ntwo!

entries.jp: 誰が渡すか！
entries.en: Like I'd hand it\nover!

entries.jp: わしの歌を聴くぜよ！
entries.en: Listen to my song!

entries.jp: 高杉　桂\n逃げるぜよ！
entries.en: Takasugi,\nKatsura! Run for\nit!

entries.jp: 君
entries.en: You...

entries.jp: ギターを弾いてたのは\nこのわしじゃ
entries.en: I'm the one who\nwas playin' the\nguitar.

entries.jp: ここはわしが\n何とかする！
entries.en: I'll handle this!

entries.jp: ギターは必ず護る\n二人は早く逃げるぜよ！
entries.en:
I'll protect the
guitar, no matter
what! You two get
outta here, quick!

entries.jp: ……君って人は
entries.en: ...Honestly, you...

entries.jp: 誰が渡すか！\nこれはわしの魂だ！
entries.en: Like I'd hand it\nover! This here's\nmy soul!

entries.jp: それに高杉たちの\nお師匠の宝だとも知った
entries.en:
Besides, now I
know it's
Takasugi and
Katsura's master's
treasure.

entries.jp: そんなに大事なもんを\n託されて　簡単に\n手放せるかよ！
entries.en:
When somebody's
trusted me with
somethin' that
precious, I ain't
just gonna give it
up!

entries.jp: テメェのことを\n信じたわけじゃねえが\nよく言った！
entries.en: Don't think I trust\nyou or anything,\nbut well said!

entries.jp: 死んでも離すなよ！
entries.en: Don't let go of it\neven if it kills\nyou!

entries.jp: わしの歌を聴くぜよ！
entries.en: Listen to my song!

entries.jp: 貴様　あくまで\nお上に楯突く気か
entries.en: You still intend to\ndefy the\nauthorities?

entries.jp: はっ　武士でもなんでも\n子供に乱暴するヤツは\nクズだ！
entries.en:
Hah! Samurai or
not, anybody who
roughs up kids is
scum!

entries.jp: それに……
entries.en: And besides...

entries.jp:
ロックが自由を
縛ろうとする
暴力なんぞに
負けるものかよ！
entries.en:
Rock ain't gonna
lose to violence
that tries to tie
freedom down!

entries.jp: なかなか\n言うじゃねえか……
entries.en: Not bad. He's got\na mouth on him...

entries.jp: ええい！\n全員　引っ立てろ！
entries.en: Enough! Haul\nthem all in!

entries.jp: なっ！　乱暴はよせ！\nギターに傷が付く！
entries.en:
Hey! Quit
roughin' us up!
You'll scratch the
guitar!

entries.jp: クズ楽器ごとき\n構うものか！
entries.en: Who cares about a\ntrashy\ninstrument!

entries.jp: おい　このガキも何か\n持ってやがるぞ\nん……雷舞のチラシ？
entries.en:
Hey, this brat's
got something
too. Hm... a flyer
for a live?

entries.jp: 返せ！\n返せよ！
entries.en: Give it back! Give\nit back!

entries.jp: ふん\n貴様ごとき町人のガキが\n雷舞を観ようとは……
entries.en:
Hmph. A
townsman's brat
like you, thinking
he can see a live...

entries.jp: 百年早い\nこれは没収する！
entries.en:
You're a hundred
years too early.
This is
confiscated!

entries.jp: \fnt1ああぁぁぁっっ！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Nooooooo!\fnt0

entries.jp: チラシを取り上げられた\n子供の目に涙が浮かぶ
entries.en:
Tears welled up
in the eyes of the
child whose flyer
had been taken.

entries.jp: それを見た龍馬の胸に\n熱い炎が宿った
entries.en:
Seeing it, a
burning fire took
hold in Ryoma's
heart.

entries.jp: \fnt1貴様っっ……！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Why, you...!\fnt0

entries.jp: ふん
entries.en: Hmph.

entries.jp: 町人は武士のおこぼれで\n天歌を聴かせていただいて\nおるのだ
entries.en:
Townsfolk are
allowed to hear
the Heaven's Song
only as scraps
from the
samurai's table.

entries.jp: 身分をわきまえい！
entries.en: Know your place!

entries.jp: う　ぐすっ……\nひぐっ
entries.en: Uu... *sniff*... *hic*

entries.jp: 音楽を楽しむんに\n身分が関係あるか
entries.en: What's rank got to\ndo with enjoyin'\nmusic?

entries.jp: 何？
entries.en: What?

entries.jp: 聴いていいのは天歌だけ？\nおこぼれにあずかれ？\nそんなのは違う
entries.en:
The Heaven's
Song is all you're
allowed to hear?
Be grateful for
scraps? That ain't
right.

entries.jp: 違わぬ\n天歌は幕府が認めし\n唯一の音楽
entries.en:
It is right. The
Heaven's Song is
the only music
the shogunate
permits.

entries.jp: 人間には　泰平がための\n定められた　役所がある
entries.en:
Every person has
a role ordained
for the sake of
peace.

entries.jp: それを壊すことは大罪！\nそもそもこのようなガキが\n歌を聴きたがることすら罪
entries.en:
To break it is a
grave crime! Why,
for brats like
these to even
want to hear
songs is a crime!

entries.jp: 罪……？　好きな音楽を\n聴きたいと思ったら\n罪なのか
entries.en:
A crime...? Wantin'
to hear the music
you love is a
crime?

entries.jp: 悲しんでる人に喜んで\nもらいたいと思って\n歌ったら罪なのか
entries.en:
Singin' because
you wanna cheer
up somebody
who's sad is a
crime?

entries.jp: だったら　そんな世界　\nわしが変えてやるぜよ
entries.en: Then I'll change a\nworld like that\nmyself, I tell ya!

entries.jp: 音楽は……！　歌は……！\nもっと自由な！　心の！\n叫びなんじゃ～～～～っ！
entries.en:
Music...! Songs...!
They're the cry!
Of a heart! That's
freeeee!

entries.jp: テメェ\nまさか　その光は……！
entries.en: You... Don't tell\nme that light is...!

entries.jp: な　なんだ？\nわしもこんなのは\nはじめて――
entries.en: Wh-what is this?\nThis is the first\ntime I've ever--

entries.jp: これは……\n松陰先生が話していた\n超魂の光！
entries.en:
This is... the light
of the Ultra Soul
that Shoin-sensei
told us about!

entries.jp: くそっ\nこんな奴が超魂の\n持ち主だってのかよ！
entries.en:
Dammit! A guy
like this has the
Ultra Soul?
Gimme a break!

entries.jp: 嘘だろ\nオレ様は信じねぇぞ！
entries.en:
No way! The
great Takasugi
refuses to believe
it!

entries.jp: 私も信じられません\nしかし　これは……
entries.en: I can't believe it\neither. But this\nis...

entries.jp: うおおおお\n体中に熱いもんが\n漲ってきたぜよ！
entries.en:
Whoooaaa!
Somethin' hot's
surgin' through
my whole body!

entries.jp: 歌が！　溢れて！\n止まらない！
entries.en: The songs! Are\noverflowin'! I can't\nstop 'em!

entries.jp: 歌うぜよ　歌うぜよ\n歌うぜよ～っっ
entries.en: I'm gonna sing!\nGonna sing!\nGonna siiiing!

entries.jp: もう引き返すつもりは\n毛頭ない♪\nもう立ち止まんない♪
entries.en:
Ain't got the
slightest plan of
turnin' back~ Ain't
gonna stand still
no more~

entries.jp: なんだ\nこの歌は……！
entries.en: This song... what\nIS it...!

entries.jp: すごい！　何もかも\nめちゃくちゃなのに……！
entries.en: Amazing! It's a\ncomplete mess,\nand yet...!

entries.jp: くっ……\n何をしている！\nひっとらえろ！
entries.en: Ngh... What are\nyou doing!? Seize\nhim!

entries.jp: しかし\nこの歌を聴くと……
entries.en: But when I hear\nthis song...

entries.jp: こうなった以上は\n何人たりとも絶対敵わない\nオーイエー♪
entries.en:
Now that it's come
to this, ain't
nobody can beat
me, no way, oh
yeah~

entries.jp: ええい　取り押さえろ！\nこの程度で我らが徳川への\n忠誠は……
entries.en:
Blast it, restrain
him! Something
like this could
never shake our
loyalty to the
Tokugawa...

entries.jp: そんなもんで\nわしのロックは\n止められんぜよ～っっ！
entries.en:
Somethin' like
that ain't gonna
stop my rock, no
siree!

entries.jp: くそっ！　テメェになんぞ\n任せていられるか\nマイクをよこせっ！
entries.en:
Dammit! Like I'd
leave this to the
likes of you!
Gimme a mic!

entries.jp: わわわっ\n何するぜよ！
entries.en: Whoa-whoa!\nWhat's the big\nidea!

entries.jp: はいはいっ\n晋作のマイクはこっち！\nベースもありますよ！
entries.en:
Here you go! Your
mic's right here,
Shinsaku! And
there's a bass, too!

entries.jp: マイクとベースも\n懐から出てきた
entries.en: The mic and the\nbass also came\nout of his robe.

entries.jp: 桂さんの懐は\n異世界にでも\n繋がってるのかよ……
entries.en:
Is Katsura-san's
robe connected to
another world or
something...?

entries.jp: まあいい\n行くぜ
entries.en: Whatever. Let's\ngo.

entries.jp: 私だけ仲間外れは\n許しませんよ
entries.en: I won't stand for\nbeing the only\none left out.

entries.jp: それに　私だって\nロックにかける想いは\n負けてないつもりです！
entries.en:
Besides, I believe
my feelings for
rock are every bit
as strong!

entries.jp: おうっ！\nくうっ　二人の演奏で\nますます漲ってきたぜよ！
entries.en:
Alright! Oof, with
you two playin',
I'm gettin' even
more fired up!

entries.jp: けっ\nテメェのためじゃねえ！
entries.en: Tch! It's not for\nyour sake!

entries.jp: つか　テメェは\n引っ込んでろ！
entries.en: Actually, you,\nbutt out!

entries.jp: そんなこと言わんと\n一緒に歌えばいいだろ！
entries.en: Don't be like that!\nWe can just sing\ntogether!

entries.jp: ふふ　熱意だけは\nありますねぇ……
entries.en: Heh. Enthusiasm,\nat least, you\nhave...

entries.jp: でもついてこれなきゃ\n置いていきますよ！
entries.en: But if you can't\nkeep up, we'll\nleave you behind!

entries.jp: おらおらっ　いくぜ～！
entries.en: C'mon, c'mon,\nhere we gooo!

entries.jp: 私も\n熱意は負けませんよ！
entries.en: I won't lose on\nenthusiasm\neither!

entries.jp: わっ　わわわっ\n二人ともすごすぎぜよ\nこんなの聴いてたら……
entries.en:
Wh-whoa-whoa!
You two are way
too amazin'!
Hearin' this...

entries.jp: わしももっと熱く！\n熱く！　熱く　熱く！\nきたきたきたぜよ～っ！
entries.en:
...I'm gettin' hotter
too! Hotter!
Hotter, hotter!
Here it comes,
here it comes,
here it COMES!

entries.jp: 歌うぜよ！\n自由への火威斗（ビート）！\n
entries.en: Let's sing! The\nbeat of freedom!

entries.jp: 世界は変わる\nわしが変える\nだから　聴くぜよ
entries.en:
The world's
gonna change. I'm
gonna change it.
So listen up!

entries.jp: これがロックじゃあっ！\n行っくぜよぉぉぉぉぉっ！
entries.en: This is rock! Here\nwe gooooooo!
